'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Adam Howland LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Username:''' MASTERJEDIADAM
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
